page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-48-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The processor includes a 504 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. Memory capacity is 372.0 GB, providing 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is equipped with 2951 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 local drives, and it does not include any GPUs.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance characteristics across multiple domains. The server demonstrates top-tier single-threaded performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2308.0 and a gzip compression rate of 36.72 GB/sec. Multi-core performance is also robust, as evidenced by a Passmark CPU score of 70422.1 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 334.21 GB/sec. Memory subsystem testing shows a strong read-only small block cached bandwidth of 3863.56 GB/sec, though large block uncached read and write speeds are more moderate at 178.52 GB/sec and 68.37 GB/sec respectively.

The hardware supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE and AMX_INT8), which accelerate cryptographic and mathematical workloads. This is reflected in a strong Passmark encryption score of 54695.16 and high LLM inference speeds, such as 341.16 tokens/sec for small model text generation. Database operations are highly efficient, with Redis SET operations reaching 88.12 million operations per second and Passmark database operations scoring 22860.29. Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and fast local NVMe SSD storage, this server is well-suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale software compilation, real-time data processing, and local LLM inference tasks.
